name: zclass_display_init
description: zClass_Display::gwDisplayInit allocates a display node, initializes default display data, inserts it into the display type list, and returns the node.
known_limits: Functional acceptance covers successful node allocation, default display fields, type-list insertion, display helpers, and empty-pool failure. tier S verification is deferred to the coherent zClass display pass.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x44fdd0 validates AllocNodeFromFreeList, null allocation returning null after error report, class id 4, calloc of 0x1c display data, default width/height 1, RGB background defaults, type-list bucket 15 insertion, DeleteNodeByType cleanup on insert failure, and node return.
The native smoke verifies display allocation, class id/data defaults, type-list insertion, helper behavior, cleanup through Object3D delete, and empty-free-list failure.
